tasks.description: Lists which scheduled automation agents send events to which others, with entry points and dangling sources. Use when asked for the event flow between automation agents.
tasks.intent: Map event flow between agent definitions and flag unknown sources.

tasks.description: Tabulates the schedules of automation agents with estimated runs per week. Use when asked for a schedule table of automation agents.
tasks.intent: Tabulate agent schedules and estimated weekly run counts.

tasks.description: Finds automation agents that are disabled or have produced no events within a threshold, and the agents they starve. Use when asked which automation agents are dormant.
tasks.intent: Report dormant agents and downstream agents starved by them.
